a: $600,000 over 3 years ($200,000 a year; no indirect costs); one grantee is later chosen for an additional $1.5 million award
dt: Proposals due Apr 27, 2027, sent by the institution as one PDF by email. The proposal cover sheet generator opens in November 2026.
e: A new program (announced Oct 15, 2026) for faculty in the chemical sciences (e.g. chemistry, chemical engineering, biochemistry, materials chemistry) who are within 15 years of promotion to tenure at a US institution (or one in a US territory) that grants a bachelor's or higher degree in the chemical sciences, to start a high-risk research direction that is a significant departure from their current or previous work and currently has no significant funding. The Foundation accepts one proposal per institution per cycle and aims to make eight grants; no citizenship requirement is stated.
n: Dreyfus Foundation Program for Transformative Research (2027)
unv: The program page gives no deadline; Apr 27, 2027 is from the Foundation's Oct 15, 2026 announcement on dreyfus.org and matches the Yale newsletter. No time of day is stated.

yale.t: Yale limited submission: internal application due Nov 16, 2026 on InfoReady (Organizer filter: Limited Submissions).
